titulo: First Planning Meeting: Encuentro Andino de Ciberseguridad
descripcion: First organizational meeting to plan the Encuentro Andino de Ciberseguridad, a collaborative virtual initiative led by the IEEE ComSoc Univalle Student Chapter with participation from student chapters across the Andean Region (IEEE Region 9). The five-day summit will foster technical knowledge exchange between academia and industry around the CIA Triad: confidentiality, integrity and availability. Planned tracks include cloud, network, software, physical and personal security.
